title: Water, River, Well, Fountain, Swamp & Drain — Flow Architecture of the Potato House
status: project flow ontology + biblical/comparative context + physical-flow boundary
purpose: Define the different water/flow symbols running through the project so source, circulation, storage, branching, stagnation and outflow are not collapsed into one generic 'water' metaphor.
master_rule: Classify the flow function before assigning spiritual value. River distributes, Well stores/accesses, Fountain emits, Rain inputs, Sea collects/mixes, Swamp entangles, Drain converges/outflows. The same water can move through several states.

project_operators.definition: A channel carrying material/information/nourishment from source through terrain toward downstream receivers.
project_operators.topology: extended path/network; may branch, merge or cross thresholds
project_operators.distinction: River is not Axis: Axis orients; River transports.

project_operators.definition: A bounded access point to stored/hidden water or knowledge beneath the visible surface.
project_operators.topology: vertical local interface between surface and depth

project_operators.definition: A place where hidden/stored water emerges into visible flow.
project_operators.distinction: Fountain is a source event; River is the continuing route.

project_operators.definition: A broad collection field where many flows accumulate and mix.
project_operators.distinction: Sea is not inherently Swamp; scale and mixing do not equal entanglement.

project_operators.definition: Distributed unresolved material with high drag, recurrence and low clarity of routes.
project_operators.distinction: Swamp is not Drain: Swamp disperses/tangles; Drain converges.

project_operators.definition: A low attractor toward which distributed flow collapses, reducing available trajectories.
project_operators.distinction: Drain can be functional disposal or pathological attractor depending what is being removed and whether viable routes remain.

eden.structure: Garden source river → division into four heads/branches
eden.lesson: A sacred source can become differentiated distribution rather than remaining at the center.

ezekiel47.structure: Temple threshold → progressively deepening river → transformed downstream waters → fish/life → trees with recurring fruit and healing leaves
ezekiel47.lesson: Sacred flow becomes meaningful by changing downstream ecology, not by staying inside the Temple.

revelation22.structure: Throne of God and Lamb → River of Life → Tree of Life → fruit → healing of nations
revelation22.lesson: Throne/authority is coupled to outgoing life-flow and generative consequence.

biblical_flow_stack.scholarly_neighbor: Harvard Theological Review notes the continuity between Ezekiel 47's sanctuary-fed trees and Revelation 22's stream of life flowing from the throne.

physical_flow_boundary.rule: Hydrology/fluid dynamics can model transport, gradient, storage and sinks, but spiritual River/Spirit language is not literal fluid physics.
formal_comparators: mass balance: change in storage = inflow - outflow ± sources/sinks
network flow: sources → channels → junctions → sinks
gradient flow: direction depends on potential/pressure/elevation under specified physical laws
physical_flow_boundary.csf_boundary: CSF is a physiological fluid with circulation/homeostatic functions. It can illuminate the project's River metaphor but is not Holy Spirit or a mystical river.

life_strife_flow_logic.life: source → clean passage → distribution → nourishment → Tree/Fruit → return
life_strife_flow_logic.strife: unresolved input → mixing/drag → Swamp → attention/archive gradient → Drain
life_strife_flow_logic.repair: identify source and sink → reopen Door/bypass → clarify channels → restore multiple viable trajectories → Garden irrigation

conversation_genealogy: 2026-07-07: Ezekiel 47 and Revelation 22 were brought into House/river/tree reading.
2026-08-31: River explicitly distinguished from Tree, Axis and Door by function.
2026-09-09: Drain already existed as a recovered operator: distributed unresolved flow → convergent low attractor.
